free_tier.stated: Personal Free Non-commercial use - Users 3 - Devices 100 - Virtual Devices 3 - Remote Gateways 1 - Remote Routes 3. Port forwarding: not included.

egress.terms: No bandwidth metering: the pricing description says 14-day free trial, no bandwidth charges. Traffic flows peer to peer.; ingress: none

interface_detail: Install, log in, connected; no configuration files described.
tooling: Netrinos client for Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android and ARM; routing through nftables, PF and WFP.
chaining: Replaces a public endpoint with a private overlay: a free VM and a laptop can reach each other without any port, but no third party can dial in.

limits.value: port forwarding not included on Personal Free
3 users, 100 devices, 1 remote gateway, 3 remote routes

binding_note: The free plan has no port forwarding at all, so a public UDP ingress does not exist to be metered; volume never becomes the question.

identity_cost.detail: Install, log in, connected. The signup page is app.netrinos.com/signup; the free tier is non-commercial use only.

reliability_note: Free tier is limited to non-commercial use, and there is no stated SLA; peer-to-peer means availability depends on the peers' own networks.
confidence_note: A measured mesh between two machines would confirm the WireGuard data plane, but it would not change the missing port-forwarding row.

evidence.proved: Personal Free: 3 users, 100 devices, 3 virtual devices, 1 remote gateway, 3 remote routes; the Port forwarding row is marked as not included.
Not a privacy VPN; a private network where devices connect peer to peer, encrypted with WireGuard. Free for personal use.

notes: Launched 2025-12-19. It is a Twingate-shaped private mesh, not an ingress provider. The free tier is explicitly non-commercial, which matters for anything a user runs as a service.

extras.wg_detail: Every connection uses WireGuard: the product page says Every connection uses WireGuard and the pricing page lists WireGuard encryption and end-to-end encryption as core features. Configs are pushed by a user rather than exported as a .conf file, and no registration API is documented.
extras.volume_stated: No bandwidth metering: the pricing description says 14-day free trial, no bandwidth charges. Traffic flows peer to peer.
extras.transit_note: Traffic flows directly between devices, with an encrypted relay as fallback.
